why: A bold phrase that opens with a member's name and a verb (Dr X asked yesterday:) is part of the current speaker's speech, not a new speaker.
title: Sample Question
html:
Mr A: Intro.

Dr Wang Kai Yuen asked yesterday: Why is it so long?

I assure him that it is not.
